blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Panfilo “Ping” Lacson on Wednesday said there were congressmen who wanted to remove in the 2027 budget a provision against political intervention in the distribution of government assistance. He said removing the anti-epal limitations could lead to the politicization of the Department of Social Welfare and Development’s (DSWD) Assistance to Individuals
